result:
Review complete — 11 confirmed findings reported, from 8 finder angles deduplicated and adversarially verified (2 candidates were refuted during verification and dropped).

The headline: this PR fixes the unavailable-verifier conflation on the global pipeline path but leaves the decomposition side worse off in two ways — `formalizeNode` still maps an offline verifier to "failed" (cascading skips across the whole auto-formalize queue), and `toNodeVerificationStatus` erases the new status entirely, so the amber banner, badge, and Re-verify button never appear in node-scoped mode. Two more behavioral regressions worth deciding on before merge: dropping the `localhost:3100` default silently kills real verification in the documented docker-compose workflow, and collapsing every non-OK verifier response into "unavailable" means one transient queue-full 503 now aborts all retries and discards the verifier's error body unlogged. The remaining findings cover the status surviving reload via the unsanitized zustand path, two UI surfaces still showing success-flavored output for unchecked proofs, stale README/ARCHITECTURE docs, the two-boolean result type that invited the `formalizeNode` bug, missing tests on the precedence helper, and a pre-existing abort-timer leak in the route.
